# Source-reading regression fixtures

These six selected dictionary records are **CC BY-SA 4.0 dictionary text**, separate from the application code license. Credit the Chinese Wiktionary contributors, and Tatu Ylonen / Wiktextract contributors via Kaikki.org.

[License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) · [Legal code](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/legalcode) · [Chinese Wiktionary copyright policy](https://zh.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:著作权)

`PROVENANCE.json` records each exact source URL, revision, retained whole-source download hash, original line number and freshly computed selected-line hash. Author histories are available at `https://zh.wiktionary.org/wiki/<headword>` and the original page history. Original directory-label partitions stay independent.

Changes: lexical projection with all quotations/examples, media/audio URLs and unrelated branches removed. Reading text, source tags and original raw tags are preserved exactly; no readings or glosses were generated. This is a curated source-format regression fixture, not pronunciation correctness or vocabulary coverage evidence. `hangeul` records Korean phonetic notation; `zh_pron` can contain multiple Chinese varieties and writing systems, not only Mandarin/Pinyin.
